description: Deterministic l4 packager plus one LLM call for the catalog description. No checkpoint.
principles: Export is mechanical: l4 without pipeline/, hashes stripped (recomputable), headers normalized to _{project}_, human text copied to i18n via textPaths.
One LLM call writes catalog.description only. No checkpoint. No import. No translation.
textPaths live on the NS contracts per schemaVersion; they are metadata, not artifact fields.
A solution is one or more modules that share level-1 roles and actors; the manifest lists modules in invocation order.

steps.goal: Catalog description (what the solution is, who it is for).
